strengths: The remediation closes both directions of the disposition contract: required original effects must be present, and a non-mutating current invocation cannot create an additional ledger effect.
The inverse invariant is independent of early/late/unknown receipt classification and future recovery results.
Regression tests preserve accepted positive counterparts and reseal complete chains, ensuring semantic rejection rather than incidental schema or chain failure.
The README makes physical invocation identity explicit and retains all execution-assembly limitations.
summary: COR-C0-006 is closed and COR-C0-001 through COR-C0-005 remain closed. Focused static review of the three-file v3 delta and bounded offline probes found no remaining actionable issue in the reviewed implementation-only artifact foundation. This disposition permits technical continuation of implementation; it is not a completed OBS1 packet, proof of runtime feasibility, or experiment/OBS1/M4 approval.
